skill.name: docx
skill.description: Create, edit, inspect, and validate DOCX files using guided Word document workflows, OOXML access, comments, tracked changes, and document conversion tools.
skill.summary: Work with DOCX files through creation, editing, comments, tracked changes, validation, and text extraction workflows.
skill.author: anthropics

security_audit.summary: The confirmed risks are expected for a DOCX manipulation skill: local file operations, ZIP package handling, temporary workspaces, subprocess calls, and privileged dependency installation guidance. Most static findings are false positives from OOXML namespace URIs, schema imports, Markdown code formatting, compact XML templates, or validation identifiers. No prompt injection attempt was found in the reviewed skill files. Static review was capped at 400/450 representative findings; omitted static matches are unconfirmed, so automatic publishing stays disabled until manual review.

remediation.suggestion: Manually review the omitted 50 static analyzer matches or reduce bundled generated/vendor/reference content before enabling automatic publication.

remediation.issue: ZIP extraction uses extractall on Office archives.
remediation.suggestion: Validate each ZIP member path before extraction and reject absolute paths or entries that escape the destination directory.

remediation.issue: Dependency instructions include sudo apt-get commands.
remediation.suggestion: Move privileged installation to prerequisites and require explicit user or administrator approval before installing system packages.

remediation.issue: Helpers invoke local external tools through subprocess.run.
remediation.suggestion: Keep command arguments fixed, avoid shell execution, document required tools, and show clear warnings before running conversions or validation.

content.value_statement: Professional Word documents often need precise edits, comments, and tracked changes without breaking formatting. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code structured DOCX workflows with OOXML tools and validation steps.
actual_capabilities: Creates new DOCX files with docx-js patterns for paragraphs, tables, images, styles, and page layout.
Unpacks DOCX files into OOXML so document XML, comments, media, relationships, and metadata can be inspected.
Edits existing Word documents through Python helpers that preserve structure and validate output files.
Adds comments and replies using provided templates for modern Word comment files.
Supports tracked-change workflows for legal, academic, business, and government document review.
Converts DOCX files to markdown, PDF, or page images when local tools are available.
limitations: Requires local dependencies such as pandoc, docx, LibreOffice, Poppler, and defusedxml for some workflows.
Works on DOCX package structure and cannot guarantee visual fidelity across every Word version.
Complex formatting may require direct OOXML inspection and careful manual validation.
Document conversion quality depends on installed local tools and fonts.

use_cases.title: Review a Contract with Tracked Changes
use_cases.description: Apply focused edits, preserve unchanged text, and produce a DOCX with professional tracked changes.

use_cases.title: Generate a Styled Report
use_cases.description: Create a new Word document with headings, tables, images, headers, footers, and consistent styles.

use_cases.title: Inspect Document Structure
use_cases.description: Unpack a DOCX file, review XML relationships, extract text, and verify comments or embedded media.

prompt_templates.title: Extract Document Text
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for reading a DOCX file.
prompt_templates.prompt: Extract the text from this DOCX file and summarize the headings, key sections, and any tracked changes.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Word Document
prompt_templates.scenario: Build a new formatted DOCX from content.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a DOCX report from this outline. Include a title page, heading styles, a table, page numbers, and a short appendix.

prompt_templates.title: Add Review Comments
prompt_templates.scenario: Annotate an existing document for review.
prompt_templates.prompt: Open this DOCX file, add comments to unclear or risky sections, and return a reviewed copy with the original text preserved.

prompt_templates.title: Apply Tracked Contract Edits
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this agreement and apply the requested clause changes as tracked changes. Use minimal edits, validate the DOCX, and report each changed section.

output_examples.input: A user provides a policy DOCX and asks for a review copy with comments on ambiguous requirements.
output: A revised DOCX file with comments anchored to the relevant paragraphs.
A short summary listing each comment and the reason it was added.
A validation note confirming the document was repacked successfully.

output_examples.input: A user asks for a quarterly report DOCX based on a markdown outline and chart image.
output: A formatted Word document with title, sections, table, image, and page layout.
A brief build summary describing included styles and inserted assets.

output_examples.input: A user requests contract edits with tracked changes for dates, party names, and payment terms.
output: A redlined DOCX file with precise insertions and deletions.
A checklist of completed edits grouped by document section.
A verification summary based on converted markdown or validation output.

best_practices: Read the relevant workflow file fully before creating, editing, or redlining a document.
Work in small batches for tracked changes and validate after each meaningful group of edits.
Keep a separate original copy so final validation can compare document structure and text.
anti_patterns: Do not replace whole paragraphs when only a few words need tracked changes.
Do not rely on markdown line numbers to locate XML nodes in Word documents.
Do not skip validation after direct OOXML edits or relationship changes.

faq.question: Can this skill create a new DOCX file?
faq.answer: Yes. It uses docx-js guidance to create Word documents with text, styles, tables, images, and page layout.

faq.question: Can it edit an existing Word document?
faq.answer: Yes. It can unpack a DOCX file, edit OOXML content, add comments, and repack the result.

faq.question: Does it support tracked changes?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes a redlining workflow for precise insertions and deletions with validation guidance.

faq.question: What dependencies may be needed?
faq.answer: Some workflows need pandoc, docx, LibreOffice, Poppler, defusedxml, Python, or Node.js.

faq.question: Can it preserve formatting?
faq.answer: It is designed to preserve DOCX structure, but complex formatting should be checked in Word after validation.

faq.question: Does it send documents to a network service?
faq.answer: No network service is required by the included scripts. It works with local files and local document tools.
